memo.headline: Investment Diligence Memo: Atomberg Technologies Limited
memo.summary: Atomberg Technologies Limited operates in the consumer electrical appliances sector, focusing on fans and BLDC motors [p. 163]. Revenue from operations grew to ₹1,293.77 crore in Fiscal 2026 from ₹959.51 crore in Fiscal 2025 and ₹796.98 crore in Fiscal 2024 [p. 163, p. 399]. However, the company continues to incur losses, reporting a restated loss after tax of ₹148.88 crore in Fiscal 2026 following a loss of ₹117.41 crore in Fiscal 2025 [p. 83]. Total equity stood at ₹186.15 crore as of Fiscal 2026, alongside current borrowings of ₹239.75 crore and non-current borrowings of ₹17.78 crore [p. 34, p. 375]. The proposed fresh issue aims to raise up to ₹450.00 crore to repay certain borrowings, fund brand awareness, invest in R&D, and for general corporate purposes, alongside an offer for sale of up to 76,541,851 equity shares [p. 150].
